settings.privacy.body: OpenWave needs no account, does not track you and never uploads your library. Everything is stored on this computer.
settings.privacy.except: Only the requests below ever leave this computer. Most happen because you did something; two small ones are made ahead of time: at start-up an anonymous visitor id is fetched, and the stream addresses of upcoming songs are looked up in advance (addresses only, never audio).
settings.privacy.headline: No data is sent
settings.privacy.list_title: OpenWave only connects to these addresses
settings.privacy.net.github: github.com: downloading and updating the helper file (yt-dlp), only if you agree.
settings.privacy.net.lrclib: lrclib.net: lyrics (only if you turn it on).
settings.privacy.net.spotify: open.spotify.com: only while you bring a Spotify playlist.
settings.privacy.net.youtube: YouTube / YouTube Music: search, song streaming and Home suggestions (sent with your language and region).
settings.privacy.row.apple: Only while importing an Apple Music link: the album or playlist from the link you pasted.
settings.privacy.row.audio: While a song plays: only the audio data of that song is requested.
settings.privacy.row.catalog: When you search or open an artist, album or list: the text you searched for or the item id. No account.
settings.privacy.row.github: Only if you agree to install the helper file: the official yt-dlp release and its checksum file.
settings.privacy.row.images: When a cover is shown, the window requests it. To tint the app with the cover's colors OpenWave also downloads a small copy from the same hosts (user agent OpenWave/version), and the Windows media overlay fetches the cover itself.
settings.privacy.row.lyrics: Only if you turn lyrics on: song title, artist, album and length.
settings.privacy.row.lyrics_ytm: Only if you turn lyrics on: the song's video id, to get YouTube Music's timed lyrics.
settings.privacy.row.player: When you play a song, and ahead of time for the next songs in the queue and the Home suggestions: only the song id and the anonymous visitor id. Only the stream address is requested, never audio. No cookies, no account.
settings.privacy.row.share: Only when you share or open a share link: the song list (song ids, titles, artists, covers) and the list name, signed with a new throwaway key each time. Stored publicly; anyone with the link can read it.
settings.privacy.row.soundcloud: When you search SoundCloud, play a SoundCloud song, or YouTube cannot play a song: the search text or that song, requested by yt-dlp.
settings.privacy.row.spotify: Only while importing a Spotify link: the list id from the link you pasted.
settings.privacy.row.spotify_account: Only if you sign in with your own Spotify app: the sign-in, then your playlists and Liked Songs when you import them.
settings.privacy.row.translate: Only when you turn on Translate in the lyrics: the lyric lines and the app language.
settings.privacy.row.update: When OpenWave starts and every 6 hours (unless turned off): asks which version is the newest. If it is newer, the installed Windows app downloads that version's installer and its checksum file.
settings.privacy.row.visitor: Once when OpenWave starts (and about every 2 hours): a request for an anonymous visitor id. No cookies, no account and no song are sent.
settings.privacy.row.ytdlp: Only if the direct way fails and yt-dlp is installed: the request yt-dlp normally makes for that one song.
